programme_detail_official.description: The NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship is a University-level scholarship offered to support exceptional students from all countries except Singapore with outstanding achievements, and is considered and shortlisted through the applicant's application for undergraduate admission to NUS. It provides 100% coverage of subsidised undergraduate tuition fees after the MOE Tuition Grant, an S$5,800 annual living allowance, an S$5,000 annual accommodation allowance and a S$1,750 one-time computer allowance upon enrolment. It is tenable for the normal candidature period, can be transferred across programmes and is renewed every semester provided a GPA of at least 3.5 and good conduct are maintained. Recipients must take up the MOE Tuition Grant and are thereby bonded to work for a Singapore-registered company for three years after graduation.
